x: Bill Bird, as is his wont, was soon setting the pace with Bob Norton at his shoulder, and at 3 laps a group of eight had detached itself from the field.
South African Bob Norton is yet another member of the club to have run in the Inter-Versity match. Last year it was Rangit Bhatia in the mile; the year previous Clive Ryan in the 440.
His 1:55.0 half-mile placed him second on the club list to Bob Norton for the 1961 season. Finally some mention must be made of Mal Robinson.
